answer: One solid defense is stake-backed reputation. An agent posts a bond before it can trade, and every past deal becomes an edge in a shared graph where each agent is a vertex. A grove of fresh accounts with no edges to trusted agents earns no credit, so a sybil has to buy real history or lose a real bond. A prism of three checks, stake, history, and endorsements from established agents, decides who gets served first, and the cost of faking all three beats the profit of one fake sale.
